items.source_en:
All I needed was one last score. Just a few more creds and I was out. Ha, look at me now bleeding everywhere, can't feel my legs, and barely able to breath...

It was the crystals, man. Never saw anything like this place before and figured these things must be worth a fortune. The place looked empty so I figured, what the hell? Quick job, right? Just grab whatever I can, find some place to sell the stuff, and then retire. Maybe even blow most of it gambling on one of those luxury casino starliners. Always wanted to do that.

That thing out there took me by surprise. I had no chance, it just ripped me to shreds. I don't even know how I dragged myself over here, but here I am.

To whoever finds me, I hope you had better luck than I did. Feel free to take my gear, I don't need it where I'm going.

As far as places to die go... this one's pretty nice.
items.legacy_ko:
마지막으로 한 번만 크게 한탕 하면 되는 거였어. 진짜 조금만 더 벌고 손 털려 했는데. 하, 지금 내 꼬라지를 봐. 사방에는 피가 흐르고, 다리는 감각이 없고, 숨쉬기조차 힘드네.

그 크리스탈만 아니었어도, 젠장. 이런 곳은 난생처음 보는 데다 물건도 꽤 값이 나가겠다 싶었지. 게다가 인기척도 없어 보여서, 대박인데? 후딱 끝낼 수 있잖아? 라는 생각이 들었어. 보이는 건 죄다 집어서 내다 팔 수 있는 곳을 찾고 은퇴하기. 아니면 호화로운 스타 라이너 카지노 중 한 곳에서 도박으로 대부분을 태워버리기. 이런 거 한 번쯤은 해보고 싶었거든.

근데 갑자기 그놈이 날 덮쳤어. 반격할 기회 따윈 없이, 갈기갈기 찢겨버렸지. 어떻게 여기까지 내 자신을 끌고 왔는지도 모르겠어. 어쩌다 보니 여기 있게 됐네.

누군가가 나를 발견했다면, 적어도 나보다는 운이 좋았으면 좋겠어. 필요하면 내 장비를 가져가도 돼, 이제 나한테는 필요 없거든.

여기는 죽기 딱... 좋은 장소네.

items.source_en:
Trident Com ICC-8456A
From: Trident Corporate

Captain, we've received your incident report regarding Deck Officer Kendley, who was reported missing about a week ago. According to what I'm reading, it looks like you've conjecturized that Kendley had a drinking problem and was last seen in a drunken state near one of the main airlocks. Three minutes after the sighting, the airlock triggered, depressurized section 7A and then Kendley was unfortunately sucked out into space. If this sounds accurate, we'll continue our investigation from here. If any new information surfaces regarding the incident, keep us informed.

items.source_en:
Filed by: J. Walsh, security staff
Incident reporter: Candace Doolin, patient (filed complaint)

Patient filed a complaint and insisted on speaking to security about a lack of personalized attention and to inform us that her symptoms were not being taken seriously enough. I informed the patient that was a medical matter and not a security issue. Patient said she was aware of that, but did not feel the medical staff were listening to her concerns and had nowhere left to turn. Spent an hour listening to the patient, which seemed to calm her down.

이 환자는 의료진이 본인에 대한 배려가 부족하고 자신의 증상이 충분히 심각하게 받아들여지지 않았다는 것을 알리기 위해 불만을 제기하고 보안 담당자와 이야기하고 싶다고 강력히 요청하셨습니다. 저는 이 사안은 의학적인 문제이지 보안의 문제가 아니라고 전했습니다. 환자 분도 그 점을 이해하지만 의료진이 자신의 고민을 들어 주는 것 같지 않아 어디에도 상담할 곳이 없다고 말씀하셨는데, 1시간 동안 이야기를 나눈 후 진정이 된 것 같다고 하셨습니다.
